name: prompt-router
description: Automatic model routing for Claude Code: sends each prompt to Haiku, Sonnet, Fable or Opus by task complexity. Local regex only, requires no external LLM or router; falls back to the default model on any error.

enabled.title: Route prompts by complexity
enabled.description: Off: every request uses the session's own model.

showStatus.title: Show the routed model in the status line
showStatus.description: Writes e.g. 'router: sonnet (coding)' after each prompt.
